decisions.reason: It has been kept visible for two years and likely extends the core offering at moderate cost, so the option value of continuing still outweighs the case for abandonment despite only limited prominence.

The seventy-two-hour program remains on the website, suggesting some demand or strategic value, but its tighter service commitment makes it somewhat more costly and therefore slightly more droppable than other retained offerings.
A dedicated page in both years indicates a stronger commitment and clearer market position, so management would likely keep this option open unless performance deteriorates materially.

The digital platform has its own page in both years and likely supports multiple product lines, making it a low-abandonment complement to the firm’s broader business once the initial investment has been made.
Its move from a simple mention to a dedicated page is a positive signal that uncertainty has resolved favorably, so management would be inclined to continue and build on it rather than exit.
